title: Make the two-profile one-request-per-action witness deterministic
outcome: Replace immediate merged-channel try_recv uniqueness checks with synchronous forwarding acknowledgement or direct wire inspection. Forwarder threads can leave an already-issued extra request in the source channel when the merged receiver looks empty, hiding the defect or attributing it to the following action.
acceptance: A deliberately duplicated request is deterministically detected in the action that issued it without timing waits.
